npm.purpose: Test the native PostgreSQL operation journal, then durable handling of a refused HTTP dispatch.
npm.scope: The first child requires a loopback administrative URL for an empty disposable server. The second requires the separate prism_runtime runtime URL and prism database. The tests perform real bootstrap, migrations, eight-way SQL concurrency, writer SIGKILL, immutable-identity and journal-negative cases.
npm.environment: Repository root through npm, installed locked native tools/dependencies and actual tracked inputs/Git objects. No root pre/post script definitions observed. Set PRISM_NATIVE_OPERATION_TEST_ADMIN_URL to an empty disposable loopback PostgreSQL server for the first child. Set PRISM_NATIVE_OPERATION_TEST_DATABASE_URL to that server’s migrated prism database using prism_runtime for the second child. The first child leaves database/roles/state for the later check; neither child drops them.
npm.effects: Creates an actual prism database, roles, schema and rows and starts a writer that is deliberately killed. Pools and owned local temporary files are cleaned, but database roles, rows and the database itself are not dropped. The second child reserves then closes a loopback port, observes an actual HTTP connection refusal and checks durable SQL records. The shell stops after a failed first child. Use only the intended disposable database and inspect partial database state before retry.
npm.expected: Native Node TAP/assertion results; selected tests must pass, failures nonzero. Skips where declared remain skips, not proof. Limits: A zero exit does not establish worker completion, a positive native-kernel path, production database safety or database cleanup.

guide.purpose: Check whether the current full lint report still observes every recorded baseline fingerprint.
guide.scope: Compare the selected baseline with one full debt-visible report bound to its exact bytes; this is not a new analyser run or a fresh application lint result.
guide.environment: Run from the repository root with a supported Node runtime and read access to the selected report and baseline. The helper uses Node built-ins; it does not run analysers or fetch a database. Before this step, produce a complete unscoped full-tier report with includeDebt=true, current baseline digest, zero changed-file scope and successful complete findings for every baseline tool. Use the canonical target-image/pinned-tool lint-report procedure to produce that input. Stop on any digest, scope, debt visibility, tool status, JSON or file error.
guide.effects: Read and parse the selected report and baseline and compute the candidate retained groups in memory. Without --write the helper does not change the baseline, create output files or execute child tools. It does not authenticate a reviewer or grant approval to remove debt.
guide.expected: Zero prints lint baseline is fresh only when no fingerprints would be removed. Stale entries throw a nonzero diagnostic giving the count and --write direction. That exact stale diagnostic permits preparing a reviewed candidate, not deletion approval; any other error is STOP. No passing application, calendar/approval or live-operation result follows from this check.
guide.changeToCheck: Changes to report/baseline schema, digest binding, tool findings, stale-entry selection, approval fields or either helper require the full lint procedure and focused helper checks. Keep original reports, exact baseline diffs and failure diagnostics. Do not turn a stale-count message into approval or change a failed report to match the desired baseline.

guide.purpose: Write a reviewed candidate that removes baseline fingerprints absent from the qualified full report.
guide.scope: The same exact report/baseline freshness selection as check mode, now with explicit --write. Review precise tool/fingerprint removals rather than relying only on a stale count.
guide.environment: Run from the repository root with a supported Node runtime and read access to the selected report and baseline. The helper uses Node built-ins; it does not run analysers or fetch a database. Before this step, produce a complete unscoped full-tier report with includeDebt=true, current baseline digest, zero changed-file scope and successful complete findings for every baseline tool. Use the canonical target-image/pinned-tool lint-report procedure to produce that input. Stop on any digest, scope, debt visibility, tool status, JSON or file error. Require write authority to the selected baseline and its directory. Retain the original baseline outside the destination and obtain the canonical owner review before adopting the candidate.
guide.effects: If stale fingerprints exist, write the filtered groups to an exclusive randomly named sibling temporary file, atomically rename it onto the selected baseline, and remove the temporary path in finally. If nothing is stale, return without rewriting. The helper does not preserve the old baseline automatically, prove reviewer approval or undo an accepted rename. The canonical procedure owns the backup, exact diff and restoration decision.
guide.expected: With removals, prints pruned N stale lint baseline fingerprint(s); with none, prints lint baseline is fresh. Review every actual removal and restore the retained original if unexpected. Run full lint again because the baseline digest changed. Zero is not proof the removed debt was approved or the new full lint succeeded.
guide.changeToCheck: Changes to report/baseline schema, digest binding, tool findings, stale-entry selection, approval fields or either helper require the full lint procedure and focused helper checks. Keep original reports, exact baseline diffs and failure diagnostics. Do not turn a stale-count message into approval or change a failed report to match the desired baseline.

guide.purpose: Add a specifically reviewed suppression group from active fingerprints in a successful selected lint tool report.
guide.scope: Requires pipeline_lint_report.v7, pipeline_lint_baseline.v2, the report’s exact current baseline digest, one successful blocking tool and nonempty valid new fingerprints. This is approved debt recording, not an analyser run, proof of a real reviewer identity or a global suppression grant.
guide.environment: Run from the repository root with Node, a retained validated report and baseline, write authority to the selected baseline and the actual reviewed tool/owner/reason/date/tracking/approval fields. Replace every example value with the approved record; do not use the historical dates as current approval. First use the canonical full target-image lint-report command. Exit 3 for actual blocking findings can supply the proposed-debt report; exit 1/tool failure cannot.
guide.effects: Reads the report and exact baseline bytes, rejects stale digest, missing fields, experimental/nonblocking tool findings, empty or already-recorded additions and malformed fingerprints. Appends a group and directly overwrites the selected baseline JSON; unlike prune, this helper has no temporary-file/atomic-rename publication. It does not execute analysers or network requests. Date checks cover ISO shape and ordering, not real calendar validity or approval authentication. Preserve the original and inspect the exact diff.
guide.expected: Prints TOOL: added N approved fingerprints after the write. Nonzero is STOP and may follow file errors; do not infer a completed safe write from a partial file. Review the exact fingerprints and run full lint after the digest changes; its policy loader validates actual calendar dates. A printed approved label does not itself prove authorisation, absence of active blocking findings or a passing current lint run.
guide.changeToCheck: Changes to report/baseline schema, digest binding, tool findings, stale-entry selection, approval fields or either helper require the full lint procedure and focused helper checks. Keep original reports, exact baseline diffs and failure diagnostics. Do not turn a stale-count message into approval or change a failed report to match the desired baseline.
